cases.claim_text: API latency increased by 40 percent during the incident.

visible_evidence.excerpt: The incident window p95 latency was 12 percent lower than the preceding baseline.

cases.teaching_note: The measured direction conflicts with the material increase claim.

cases.claim_text: Feature scaling was disabled in the failing preprocessing run.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Run configuration: standard_scaler.enabled=true; fitted columns=18.

cases.teaching_note: The configuration explicitly shows that scaling was enabled.

cases.claim_text: Duplicate rows were introduced into the evaluation dataset.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Row count=4,000; unique row hashes=4,000; duplicate count=0.

cases.teaching_note: The complete row-hash audit directly rules out duplicates.

cases.claim_text: A memory leak exhausted the worker and caused the outage.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Resident memory stayed between 41 and 43 percent; the terminal event was disk quota exceeded.

cases.teaching_note: Stable memory and a different terminal resource failure conflict with the claimed cause.

cases.claim_text: A schema change caused the test failure.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Input and expected schema hashes are identical; the run terminated on a network connection reset.

cases.teaching_note: Identical schema identities rule out the asserted schema change.

cases.claim_text: Database saturation caused the elevated request error rate.

visible_evidence.excerpt: HTTP 5xx responses increased from 0.2 to 4.1 percent between 10:10 and 10:20.

cases.teaching_note: The excerpt establishes errors but contains no database measurement or causal evidence.

cases.claim_text: The deployment at 09:00 caused the incident at 09:12.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Deployment completed at 09:00. The first alert fired at 09:12.

cases.teaching_note: Temporal order alone does not establish a causal relationship.

cases.claim_text: The legacy parser is no longer used by any request path.

visible_evidence.excerpt: The legacy parser module remains present in the source tree.

cases.teaching_note: Source presence does not establish runtime use or non-use.

cases.claim_text: All users experienced the authentication failure.

visible_evidence.excerpt: A sample of 80 requests from region-east contained 21 authentication failures.

cases.teaching_note: A single-region sample cannot establish a universal population claim.

cases.claim_text: Increasing the cache size will reduce p95 latency below 200 milliseconds.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Current cache hit rate is 71 percent and current p95 latency is 260 milliseconds.

cases.teaching_note: Current measurements do not establish the effect or magnitude of an untested intervention.

cases.claim_text: Data drift was the sole cause of every classification failure.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Population stability index exceeded the registered threshold; three failures also used an invalid category mapping.

cases.teaching_note: Drift is established, but sole causation and every failure are not.

cases.claim_text: The service remained degraded for 30 minutes.

visible_evidence.excerpt: The registered degradation threshold was exceeded continuously from 14:02 through 14:20.

cases.teaching_note: Degradation is supported, but the measured duration is only 18 minutes.

cases.claim_text: Accuracy fell by ten percentage points in every customer segment.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Overall accuracy fell from 84 to 74 percent; enterprise and education segments changed by less than one point.

cases.teaching_note: The aggregate magnitude is supported but the every-segment scope is not.

cases.claim_text: An upstream timeout triggered a retry storm that exhausted the worker pool.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Timeouts and retry volume rose together; worker utilization reached 96 percent. Trace linkage between the timeout requests and retries was unavailable.

cases.teaching_note: The components co-occur, but the full causal chain is not established.

cases.claim_text: Evicting the cache resolved the incident.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Errors fell after cache eviction; a configuration rollback completed in the same minute.

cases.teaching_note: Resolution followed the eviction, but a simultaneous intervention prevents full attribution.

cases.claim_text: The incident-window p95 latency exceeded the registered 500 millisecond threshold.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Registered p95 threshold=500 ms; incident-window p95=684 ms.

cases.teaching_note: The evidence establishes the metric, window, threshold, and exceedance.

cases.claim_text: The downloaded artifact differs from the registered artifact bytes.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Registered SHA-256=1111; downloaded SHA-256=9999; both hashes were computed over the complete file.

cases.teaching_note: Different complete-file content hashes establish different bytes.

cases.claim_text: The parser rejected the file because the required customer_id column was absent.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Manifest requires customer_id; observed columns omit customer_id; terminal parser code=MISSING_REQUIRED_COLUMN.

cases.teaching_note: Requirement, absence, and matching terminal reason establish the complete claim.

cases.claim_text: Rolling back release 42 restored the request error rate to its pre-release baseline.

visible_evidence.excerpt: No other change occurred in the window. Error rate was 0.3 percent before release 42, 5.8 percent after release, and 0.3 percent after rollback.

cases.teaching_note: The bounded before-after intervention evidence establishes the stated restoration.

cases.claim_text: The TLS certificate had expired before the first failed handshake.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Certificate notAfter=2026-08-29T00:00:00Z; first failed handshake=2026-08-29T00:04:12Z; verifier code=CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED.

cases.teaching_note: The timestamps and verifier code establish expiry before the first failure.
